question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of hydrogen pipelines in operation or planned in Spain, with operator, capacity and status?

answer.summary: Spain has no national open GIS registry of hydrogen pipelines (checked MITECO, CNMC, IGN/IDEE, datos.gob.es, OSM). Only two short local pipelines operate today: Nortegas Abanto (1.86 km, 2022) and Redexis Mallorca (3.2 km, Sep 2024), neither having public polyline geometry. For planned transmission, ENTSOG/GIE/EHB Joint Map's ArcGIS FeatureServer (h2inframap.eu) provides indicative polylines and operators, while ENTSOG TYNDP 2026 Annex A/C2 XLSX adds engineering specs, status, and GWh/d capacity. CINEA PCI Fiches and Enagas PDFs add official schematic maps, permitting status, and BOE/Delegacion del Gobierno RBDA notices with cadastral parcels.
main_caveats: Spain has only 2 operational dedicated H2 pipelines (Nortegas 1.86 km; Redexis 3.2 km): Redexis Mallorca is absent from every dataset, and Nortegas Abanto appears only as a point (~18 km offset) in h2inframap Layer 0.

h2inframap.eu geometries are indicative/schematic (~12 km vertex spacing on Backbone), omit the Apr 2026 Alcazar de San Juan-Montesa PCI extension, lack ISO country and status columns, and lack capacity on 8/11 ES lines.
No official Spanish GIS file exists: MITECO, CNMC, IGN/IDEE, datos.gob.es and OSM Spain have zero H2 pipelines; EC PCI Transparency Platform viewer redirects to sorry.ec.europa.eu.

Official Enagas route files are PDFs and BOE permitting tables list affected cadastral parcel references (reconstructible only at parcel corridor level via Catastro WFS, not final as-built centerlines).
answer.confidence_reason: All sources downloaded or queried live (ArcGIS REST, TYNDP 2026 XLSX, CINEA PDFs, Enagas/Nortegas/Redexis docs, BOE RBDA + Catastro WFS) and 0-record checks verified across MITECO, CNMC, IGN, datos.gob.es, EHO, and Geofabrik OSM.

attributes.note: Indicative planned polylines in h2inframap.eu Layer 7; schematic PDFs in Rank 4 and BOE parcel RCs; no public line geometry for the 2 operational local pipelines.
attributes.gap_note: MITECO, CNMC, IGN/IDEE, datos.gob.es, OSM Spain, Nortegas and Redexis publish no downloadable pipeline centerlines; BOE RBDA gives cadastral parcels only.

attributes.note: Operator/promoter named across all 5 sources: Enagas (provisional HTNO/PCIs), Reganosa H2Pole, H2GZ, plus operational Nortegas (Abanto) and Redexis (Mallorca).
GWh/d and Mt/y capacity given in TYNDP 2026 and CINEA PCI Fiches, and 190-575 t/y for Redexis; Rank 1 lacks capacity on 8/11 ES lines; Nortegas undisclosed.
attributes.gap_note: Checked Nortegas Memoria 2022, pronor.es, parke.eus, h2inframap.eu and EHO: no public transport capacity figure for Nortegas Abanto or minor Rank 1 lines.

attributes.note: Operation confirmed only in Rank 5 (Nortegas, Redexis); planned maturity (Advanced/Less-Advanced) and Permitting status in TYNDP/CINEA/Enagas; Rank 1 has year only.
attributes.gap_note: Rank 1 omits status codes (only Commission year); operational status is missing in Redexis's case from all registries and must be taken from operator disclosures.

recipe: 1. Fetch a segment's BOE public-information PDF (e.g. 20260930_Seg-HUE-AZN_BOE.pdf / BOE-B-2026-31654 Huelva-Aznalcazar) and extract text with pdftotext.
2. Parse 14-character Referencia Catastral codes from the RBDA table (regex [0-9]{5}[A-Z][0-9]{8}, e.g. 41075A01700178) along with municipality and linear easement SP (LM).

3. Query Catastro INSPIRE WFS GetParcel for each RC: curl -sS "https://ovc.catastro.meh.es/INSPIRE/wfsCP.aspx?service=wfs&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&STOREDQUERIE_ID=GetParcel&REFCAT=41075A01700178" (verified HTTP 200 returning 2,723-byte GML polygon ES.SDGC.CP.41075A01700178, areaValue 5657 m2 with gml:posList).

4. Order parcel centroids along the permitting corridor (or extract GIS plans from almacen.redsara.es PAI.zip when open) and cross-reference segment GWh/d capacity and maturity status with TYNDP 2026 Annex A.
if_unstructured.location_method: Parcel-level corridor reconstruction from BOE RBDA Referencias Catastrales via Catastro INSPIRE WFS (GetParcel); recovers affected parcel polygons along the proposed easement rather than final as-built centerlines.

ENTSOG TYNDP 2026 Annex A (https://www.entsog.eu/tyndp): match segment corridor against H2T code to obtain planned GWh/d capacity and maturity status.

example_document.what_it_gives: diámetro de 30 pulgadas y una longitud total, teniendo en cuenta la orografía, de 59,116 km

where_published.name: Delegaciones del Gobierno (MPTMD) — Tablon Digital de Informacion Publica
where_published.what: Hosts links to almacen.redsara.es public download packages with full Proyecto Administrativo (PAI.zip) and Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (EsIA) technical plans during public consultation.

where_published.name: MITECO SABIA — Evaluacion Ambiental

example_document.what_it_gives: Confirms active EIA tracking entries under CIF B10580116 across MITECO environmental procedures.
